news.title: Automakers largely sit out 2026 Super Bowl advertising amid industry uncertainty
news.description: Automakers are largely sitting on the advertising sidelines during this year's Super Bowl amid broader uncertainty in the U.S. automotive industry.

news.title: Epstein files: Republican lawmaker Massie calls for Trump Commerce chief Lutnick to resign
news.description: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick previously said on a podcast that he had cut ties with the notorious sex offender since an initial 2005 encounter.

news.title: Hims & Hers pulls copycat weight-loss pill after threats of legal action
news.description: Hims & Hers on Saturday announced it would stop offering its copycat of the weight-loss pill Wegovy after threats of legal action.
